body:
The warrior’s eyes glow like burning coals beneath the visor of her helm, and a faint smell of brimstone hovers about her.

Cheitan Fighter
CR 10

XP 9,600
Female cheitan human fighter 9
NE Medium outsider (native)
Init +7; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +7

DEFENSE

AC 27, touch 12, flat-footed 25 (+9 armor, +2 Dex, +3 natural, +3 shield)
hp 103 (9d10+36 plus 9)
Fort +12; Ref +8; Will +6; +2 vs. fear
Defensive Abilities bravery +2; Resist fire 20

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 40 ft. (perfect)
Melee +1 longsword +20/+15 (1d8+12/17–20) or 2 slams +17 (1d6+8)
Special Attacks weapon training (heavy blades +2, natural +1)
Spell–like Abilities (CL 9th):

3/day—detect magic, produce flame, scorching ray (1 ray)
1/day—pyrotechnics, wall of fire

STATISTICS

Str 25, Dex 17, Con 18, Int 11, Wis 12, Cha 15
Base Atk +9; CMB +16; CMD 29
Feats Blind-FightB, Cleave, Great Cleave, Great Fortitude, Improved Critical (longsword)B, Improved Initiative, Iron WillB, Lightning Reflexes, Power AttackB, Weapon Focus (longsword)B, Weapon Specialization (longsword)B
Skills Climb +11, Fly +7, Handle Animal +10, Intimidate +10, Perception +8, Ride +5, Sense Motive +4
Languages Common
SQ armor training
Gear +1 half-plate, +1 heavy steel shield, +1 longsword

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Heat (Ex)

A cheitan’s body deals 1d3 points of extra fire damage whenever it hits in melee with a natural attack or in each round it maintains a hold while grappling.

Editor’s Note

Base template: Cheitan

ECOLOGY

Environment Material Plane
Organization solitary
Treasure NPC
